node.title: Exact simple-pole floor through the maximal cyclic residual prefix
node.statement: At the official n=2^41, k=2^40 rate-half row, take c=2^22,d=2048 and the maximal legal residual prefix s=c-1. The cyclic list L_q=ceil(C(524287,264192)/(524288*q^2047)) gives epsilon_ca,epsilon_mca >= L_q(q-n)/(q(q-n+kL_q)) > 2^-83 at excess dc+s=8,594,128,895 and every smaller positive excess, uniformly for q<2^256. This refutes the former fixed safe point at excess 8,592,912,739.
